passage.label: swear twilight glow night what envelops moon becomes full; surely experience state after state; what matter not believe; Quran recited not prostrate; disbelieved deny; Allah most knowing what keep within; give tidings painful punishment; except believe righteous deeds reward uninterrupted

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ

mainSubject.label: Oaths by the twilight glow, the night and what it envelops, and the moon when full, establishing that they will surely experience state after state; their failure to believe questioned along with their refusal to prostrate when the Quran is recited; disbelievers denying while Allah knows best what they conceal within, told to receive tidings of painful punishment — except those who believe and do righteous deeds, for whom the reward is uninterrupted

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the labour-toward-the-Lord address (6) before the two-record contrast opens (7); P2 ends with the Lord-was-Seeing correction (15) before the twilight-night-moon oaths begin (16); P3 runs through the state-after-state declaration, prostration refusal, concealed-knowledge affirmation, punishment tidings and the believing exception (16-25).
